writes) · use file or shell tools · see anything
on disk (empty working directory)

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
As-of guard (mode = replay): tools return only
trace.recorded_time lte T · human_outcome_json
and the answer key unreachable from any tool

div.style: color: rgb(37, 16, 74) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Investigator loop (Claude Agent SDK, TS)
in-process MCP tools, same names in replay and live
model = the tier the router chose

memory.facts (party, predicate, as-of date)

span.p:
2nd · policy
memory.policies · policy_memo.lookup
workbook.lookup (Q2 close workbook)

span.p:
ledger.* : open_invoices, get_invoice,
party_history, trial_balance, account_activity
bank.* : get_transaction, unmatched

mail.search · mail.get_thread · chat.search

crm.owner · crm.notes

Function read tools: ap.bills/po/receipt/

forecast.get · audit.* · report.variance

4th · precedent
memory.similar_decisions
(same kind and party, kernel-accepted only)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Evidence capture: claim + trace_id
+ quote = exact span copied from trace.payload_json
each hit logged to the decision timeline

span.p:
Empty-model-response guard (F-10):
raise on finish_reason = length or blank content
never render an empty response

span.p:
Which write tool ended the run ?
propose_entry · escalate(question) · handoff
close.mark · record_fact_candidate · finish

span.p:
propose_entry(Proposal) · the ONLY write path
Proposal: intent_id, function, party_id + fields

kind: apply_payment, credit_memo, write_off,
customer_credit, dispute_hold, approve_bill,
hold_bill, schedule_payment, bank_adjustment,
rev_recognition, accrual, amortization, payroll_accrual, no_action

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
applications[]: doc_id, amount_cents
entries[]: account, debit_cents, credit_cents, memo
terms_change (optional): pct_off, until

evidence[]: claim, trace_id,
quote (optional)

policy_refs[] · fact_refs[]
judgment[]: note,

non-negative, required arrays, ISO dates

Fiscal-window date guard (F-09):
every entry, fact and terms date inside the
open fiscal window, else reject (invented year)

span.p:

kernel_verdict, checkable_num, checkable_den
Mark: cls F / E / P / J · check · status
pass / fail / judgment · detail · refs[]

span.p:
kernel.run(proposal, workpaper, approver)
deterministic, no model call
+ pack-specific extra checks from the function pack

PREPARER_EQUALS_APPROVER (G-02)
also a storage-layer constraint

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PERIOD_LOCKED (G-03): period.status = locked
correct via a new entry in the open period

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
RULE_ABOVE_APPROVER_AUTHORITY (G-04):
cited policy or fact exceeds approved_by ceiling

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
BANK_DETAILS_CHANGED (B-17): vendor remit-to

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
OVER_APPROVER_LIMIT (B-24): 14,000 bill vs
Controller limit 10,000 → next authority level

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Verdict: ACCEPT only if no mark fails
leftover judgment marks → reviewer sign-off
any fail → reject, failed marks written to
workpaper.kernel_verdict

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Checkable fraction =
machine-re-performed marks / all marks
→ checkable_num / checkable_den

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Rule: a kernel reject escalates ONE tier
0 → 1 → 2 → 3, failed marks passed as context
after tier 3 rejects → ESCALATE or REFUSE

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
decision.mode = replay ?
yes → never posts, scored against the
hidden human outcome → replay_result

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
replay_result: decision_point_id, decision_id,
agrees, diff_json, triage · scored in CODE against
human_outcome_json, which no agent tool can read

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Autonomy ladder for this decision kind
(counts always shown)

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
auto-post: replay agreement gte 95%
with n gte 5 AND a covering
policy or fact in the refs

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
post-with-review:
replay agreement gte 80%

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
shadow: everything else
proposal shown beside the human work
nothing posts without a human

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Materiality: abs amount gte $500 (50000 cents)
or new kind / new party
or leftover judgment marks ?

div.style: color: rgb(37, 16, 74) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Controller agent on GPT (different model family)
independent reviewer: re-reads workpaper + evidence,
signs J marks, approves within its authority

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Approval matrix (policy memo): pick the approver
whose limit gte amount · preparer excluded
over limit → next authority level

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Tier 3 rejected or budget cap hit:
is there a candidate with named unknowns ?

span.p: AUTO

span.p: PROPOSE

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: ESCALATE

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: REFUSE

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: BLOCK

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
AUTO persists: decision actor = agent tier,
autonomy_level auto, workpaper accept,
no human touched it

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PROPOSE persists: decision pending approval,
workpaper + evidence, controller note,
then approver and approved_at

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ESCALATE persists: escalation row (asked_user from
crm.owner, question_json naming what is NOT known,
slack_ts), investigation trail,
checklist_item.blocked_reason

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
REFUSE persists: decision kind no_action,
every tool query and trace searched,
guard or reason that fired · no proposal rendered

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
BLOCK persists: blocked attempt + rule name,
approver click, the original payment and bank line,
event entry.blocked

div.style: color: rgb(63, 37, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Human approver in Slack
approve / reject / correct
workpaper and evidence attached

div.style: color: rgb(63, 37, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Context owner in Slack
(the person who knows) answers once
→ escalation.answer_json

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Post gate, EVERY post: kernel re-run with approver
identity (human, controller agent, or none for AUTO)
P marks + the 6 hard BLOCK rules
a human click cannot override

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Post: one SQLite transaction
source_decision_id links entry → decision → intent

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
LOCAL LEDGER = system of record
gl_entry: id, period, date, source_decision_id, memo
gl_line: entry_id, account, debit_cents,
credit_cents, customer_id, vendor_id

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
artifact: decision_id, intent_id, function,

One-way QuickBooks mirror (local → QBO only)
native Invoice / Payment / CreditMemo / Bill

idempotent on fn: external id

Credit memo applied via a zero-amount Payment

span.p:
event on the bus: ts, topic, from_function,
intent_id, payload_json · e.g. ar.credit_memo.posted
consumed by revenue, forecast, close, audit

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
checklist_item ticked via close.mark:
status, decision_ids_json

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Trace closed: model_calls, cost_micros,
latency by tier finalised
timeline visible in the console

div.style: color: rgb(6, 43, 44) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
record_fact_candidate(fact): predicate,
value_json, scope_json, valid_from / valid_to,
learned_at, source_trace_ids_json, stated_by

div.style: color: rgb(6, 43, 44) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
fact approved: approved_by = the authorised answerer,
else the controller (sheet 05) · status → active
inherits the authority ceiling of its approver (G-04)
read by tier 0 and memory.* tools

div.style: color: rgb(6, 43, 44) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Evidence-changed hook (H-6 / F-06): a cited trace is
re-versioned (same external_id, new recorded_time)
→ decisions citing trace_id reopened, verdict stale,
artifact.unwound_at set → re-run, route ESCALATE
